website.note: No corporate /pipeline page exists; Twist is a synthetic biology platform / tools company, not a clinical-stage drug developer

ctgov.note: No Phase 1-3 trials with Twist Bioscience as lead sponsor

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Twist Bioscience is a synthetic-DNA / biotechnology tools and services company (silicon-based DNA synthesis, oligo pools, NGS target enrichment, antibody discovery libraries). Its Twist Biopharma Solutions segment performs antibody discovery and optimization for partners but Twist does not own or sponsor any wholly owned clinical-stage therapeutic assets. The 10-K (FY2025) does not disclose any internal Phase 1/2/3 programs and ctgov returns zero Twist-sponsored interventional Phase 1-3 trials.

commercial_product.primary_franchise: Synthetic DNA products (genes, oligos, libraries), NGS target-enrichment kits, DNA data storage R&D, antibody discovery services (Twist Biopharma Solutions)

excluded_preclinical: Partner antibody discovery programs run via Twist Biopharma — outcomes/clinical advancement belong to the partner, not Twist
excluded_partner_owned: Any antibody candidates discovered through Twist Biopharma libraries that subsequently advance into the clinic are owned and sponsored by partner pharma/biotechs
